high_level_description: The image shows an open book with a page that contains a section titled "Box 3 Continued." The text discusses the inefficiencies of natural selection as a means of evolving intelligence, mentioning the use of increasingly difficult intelligence tests and the wasteful production of mutations that have consistently been lethal. It also notes that evolution fails to take advantage of statistical similarities in the effects of different mutations. Below the text is a graph plotting speed on a logarithmic scale against years from 1935 to 1955.
